Keep commercial claims reporting routes close at hand.
LIBERTY MUTUAL | INDEPENDENT AGENTS
Subject: A clear first step for the Watkins service team

Make the reporting handoff easier to find

Hello Watkins commercial client service team,

Your team’s claims advocacy spans reporting, adjuster follow-up and loss-history review. At the first call, a clear reporting route gives that work a useful starting point.

Liberty Mutual’s commercial claims page brings together separate routes for property and casualty, specialty and surety. It also distinguishes small-business customers from midsize and large accounts.

Keep it alongside your service references and use it to:

  • Confirm which policy and claim type the client is calling about.
  • Find the corresponding reporting route.
  • Record the handoff and next follow-up in your existing workflow.

A short walkthrough could make those steps easier to reference across the team. If useful, reply with one common type of service request to use as a starting point.

Follow the reporting and notice instructions in the applicable policy.
